prompt:
Image 1 is the exact character: A chibi blonde witch girl floating in the air, long golden hair in low braids, violet eyes, a big purple witch hat with a golden crescent moon and stars, a purple and gold star-patterned cape, black shorts and black thigh boots, a spellbook at her hip, holding a dark star-orb staff in her right hand. Keep her identity, face, costume, colours, proportions, line style and the exact staff design from Image 1, at the same size and camera distance as Image 1, three-quarter view facing screen-right like Image 1. Do NOT mirror her: her face, chest and the staff stay on the screen-right side exactly as in Image 1, the hat tip and braids on the screen-left side.

Draw ONE single full-body sprite of her the instant a hard blow hits her from screen-right while she floats: her whole body is knocked back toward screen-left and tilted back about 15 degrees, head snapped back, a clear pained face with eyes squeezed shut, eyebrows knitted and teeth clenched (NOT smiling), her free left arm flung back behind her, her right hand still gripping the staff which is jolted outward and tilted back, her knees pulled up, her long hair, braids, hat tip and cape whipping forward toward screen-right from the jolt. A clear, readable silhouette that is obviously a hit reaction, not a pose of joy.

Background: 100% solid flat pure green #00FF00, no gradient, no floor, no shadow. Nothing on the character is green: keep the staff orb and every gem in the colours of Image 1. Centered, the whole character and staff fully inside the image with a wide green margin on all four sides. Clean anime game sprite, crisp lines, same rendering as Image 1. No glow, aura, lightning, sparks, impact star, particles, speed lines, sweat drops, text or labels.

precheck.summary: Flat #00FF00 background with a wide margin, the whole character and staff are fully inside the frame, and no text or extra figures appear. The blonde braids, purple star-patterned hat and cape, black shorts, thigh boots and spellbook match the reference. The pained expression (eyes shut, teeth clenched) and the knocked-back pose fit the prompt. The staff orb is dark with a purple gem, unlike the reference's crescent-orb staff, but the prompt itself described a dark star-orb staff, so this is a prompt-following discrepancy rather than a clear defect.
